notes.title: IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI HD - THE COLORFUL WORLD IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b][h1]IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI HD - THE COLORFUL WORLD IS NOW OFFICIALLY RELEASED ON STEAM![/h1][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591380/Irotoridori_No_Sekai_HD__The_Colorful_World/

[b]Story:
Our story follows Kanoue Yuuma, an amnesiac boy with a special power, and Nikaidou Shinku, a translucent girl only visible to Yuuma who gave him that power. With it, he can heal any and all wounds.
But it comes at the cost of the memories he's made.
He lives a simple life: going to school and being scolded by his childhood friend, Kisaragi Mio, by day, and working with his master, Natsume Suzu, in the evenings.
However, whenever he falls asleep, he always sees the same dream... a white world, feathers falling, and a girl calling out for him to save her.
The student dormitory his master resides in has a special door in the basement, which connects their world to a myriad of different parallel ones. He travels from world to world, searching for one that resembles the scenery he sees in his dreams, but to no avail.

Then, one night, as he's out at night strolling around town, he spots a girl jumping from the lighthouse.
Yuuma rushes over and heals her using his power, but after coming to, the girl claims to know him and his power, and asks him much like the voice in his dreams:

"Please save me, Kanoue Yuuma."[/b]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33069582/8d8263be747f7de5135e47b403f9bec8f87a9a69.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone!
Today we have some minor hotfixes for you:[/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Fix sprites reappearing after animations in some scenes
[*] Fix misplaced backgrounds after skipping text in some scenes
[*] Use BGM volume settings for movies to prevent big volume changes
[*] Fix duplicate backlog entries around choices
[*] Fix auto mode speed settings not being respected
[*] Fix character voice volume slides not being respected
[/list][/b]

We hope you have a great time with the game!

notes.title: 《未来广播与人工鸽》现已发售！
notes.content:
[h2]夺回天空与“联系”的故事——《未来广播与人工鸽》现已发售！首促仅需69元。游戏内置简繁日英4版本，拥有超越原版的高清画质，支持Steam成就以及云存储等功能，也支持大量额外内容。

本作是日本美少女游戏知名品牌Laplacian制作的一款科幻题材作品。曾荣获美少女游戏大赏综合第8、剧本第4、原画第3、音乐第5、影片第6以及角色第13（叶月辉夜）的殊荣。

常见QA：

[b]Q：如何切换多语言版本？[/b]
A：在游戏主界面进入CONFIG页面，在画面左下方的按钮可以在简繁日英四个版本之间进行切换。

[b]Q：能否提供一份攻略？[/b]
A：请访问官网商城以获取简明攻略。

[b]Q：如何获取游戏的额外内容？[/b]
A：请前往联合发行商NekoNyan的官方网站查询相关信息。[/h2]
